digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in global configuration with zero diagnostics across src/rebar and tests.
Timestamp validation must use explicit UTC timezone semantics: epoch seconds converted with datetime.timezone.utc, persisted strings assigned UTC, both producing identical UTC hour clusters.
Security-pin cadence decisions must obtain an aware current instant with explicit tz argument, convert to host timezone, and extract local date for calendar-based staleness checks.
All datetime construction in production code must use datetime.timezone.utc; the literal datetime.UTC token is prohibited under py310 target.
Timezone invariance must be proven by running validation behavior under multiple TZ environment values on platforms providing time.tzset.
